name: Togura (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Togura town emblem in white: an outlined cog-like ring with spokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Togura in Nagano Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-09-01.

features.role: Togura town emblem — an outlined cog-like ring with spokes enclosing a stylised character
